devices.name: Hyperbole
devices.definition: Deliberate exaggeration, not meant literally, that drives a point home vividly.

devices.name: Catachresis
devices.definition: One word used for another only remotely related — a deliberately incongruous transfer.

devices.name: Rhetorical question
devices.definition: A question asked for effect, not for an answer — to affirm, deny, or provoke thought.

devices.name: Synonymia
devices.definition: Amassing synonyms — words of like meaning — to enforce and enlarge a point.

devices.definition: Deliberate understatement — belittling a thing to magnify it, or lessening to increase the effect.

devices.definition: Repetition of like-sounding words, especially from a foreign tongue — sound-play across languages.

devices.name: Repeated negation
devices.definition: Two or more negatives heaped together in Greek to deny all the more emphatically.

devices.name: Chronographia
devices.definition: Description of a time or season by its marks rather than by naming it.

devices.name: Hendiadys
devices.definition: One idea expressed by two words joined with “and,” the second really qualifying the first.

devices.name: Antonomasia
devices.definition: A proper name replaced by a descriptive title, or a title by a proper name (“the Son of man”).

occurrences.note: And when [ I brake ] the seven among four thousand: i.e., the seven loaves

devices.name: Antithesis
devices.definition: Two opposite ideas set side by side so each sharpens the other.

devices.name: Metaphor
devices.definition: An implied comparison that calls one thing another (“A is B”), without “like” or “as.”

occurrences.note: There was (i.e., there became) a great calm, and the storm was changed (or turned into) into calm

devices.name: Hypocatastasis
devices.definition: Comparison by implication: the thing compared is not named at all, only the image (“Beware the leaven…”).

devices.name: Enigma
devices.definition: A dark saying — a truth wrapped in obscure or riddling terms.

devices.name: Oxymoron / paradox
devices.definition: A pointed pairing of apparently contradictory terms that expresses a deeper truth.

devices.name: Epanorthosis
devices.definition: Recalling a word just used to correct or strengthen it (“not I, but the Lord”).

devices.name: Ecphonesis
devices.definition: An outcry of feeling — a sudden exclamation breaking from strong emotion (“O the depth!”).

devices.name: Protherapeia
devices.definition: Conciliation — softening words used first to win a hearing for what follows.
